# id: PG-gate-86-balance-swimming-fs
# covers: PG 194 (Section L balance sweep, generated by tools/balance_driver.py gen; edit the generator, not this file)
# variant: pg_formulas on (FormulaScaling), professions written as <prof>_fs
# gate: validation gate (RUN_ORDER.md): g1 skill 25 gear none, g2 skill 25 gear own50, g3 skill 90 gear none, g4 skill 25 gear none, same fixture and method as the matrix file
# fixture: Testing-Save-Full-Base (squad Beaks + Avarek)
# reset: fresh
# needs: ProfessionGearProgression.dll 36D7474D+ (pg_statprobe), harness c5a5c88+ (give artifacts, research start any; 90a0e33: teleport moved=/bed, speed hold; 6933d0f: fill topup, drop all; 616121b: benches near; c4fa520: pin, d91fe88: face) (KAH 24: chance, detect, detecttime, healtime, findwater, swimtime, construct, construction); client kah.py from the harness repo (LONG_COMMANDS has the KAH 24 timers); set_test_mode.ps1 -Mode Forced -Rules InGameTest
# design: Avarek is teleported to deep water at Treefall (-62153 100 34366.6, findwater: depth 28.6, best run +z 300 m)
#   per point and swims 60 m along +z (swimtime). Result = swim_speed (deep distance / deep
#   seconds); runspeed adds the game's own swim_speed/max_swim_speed (harness 740ba0a+).
# verify: water_level=deep at every start; deep_fraction near 1; own50 > none = swimming reads the hooked stat.
#   Data: python3 tools/balance_driver.py csv <out> > balance.csv; python3 tools/analyze_balance.py balance.csv
@wait-world
@sleep 8
speed 0
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 4
speed 0
protect Beaks on
protect Avarek on
hunger Avarek 280
hunger Beaks 280
select Avarek
clearjobs Avarek
pg_statprobe on Avarek
pg_formulas on ~ formulaScaling=1 hooks=8/8
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek -62153 100 34366.6 ~ moved=1
speed 1 hold
@sleep 8
speed 0
findwater Avarek radius 300 depth 25 ~ best_run=
give Avarek "Iron Hat" 1
equip Avarek "Iron Hat"
pg_info Avarek "Iron Hat" ~ equipped=1
# --- g1: skill 25, gear none ---
setstat Avarek swimming 25
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_bonus Avarek swimming ~ equipped_bonus=0% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek -62153 100 34366.6 ~ moved=1
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
water Avarek ~ water_level=deep
@set RS runspeed Avarek ~ (swim_speed=[\d.]+ max_swim_speed=[\d.]+)
stat Avarek swimming
runspeed Avarek
@set T swimtime Avarek 60 +z ~ (deep_seconds=[\d.]+ deep_dist=[\d.]+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,194,swimming_fs,25,0,none,g1,swim,0,${T},${RS}
pg_statprobe read
hunger Avarek 280
# --- g2: skill 25, gear own50 ---
setstat Avarek swimming 25
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_force_affix Avarek "Iron Hat" swimming 50 tier 6 ~ affixes=
pg_bonus Avarek swimming ~ equipped_bonus=50% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek -62153 100 34366.6 ~ moved=1
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
water Avarek ~ water_level=deep
@set RS runspeed Avarek ~ (swim_speed=[\d.]+ max_swim_speed=[\d.]+)
stat Avarek swimming
runspeed Avarek
@set T swimtime Avarek 60 +z ~ (deep_seconds=[\d.]+ deep_dist=[\d.]+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,194,swimming_fs,25,50,own50,g2,swim,0,${T},${RS}
pg_statprobe read
hunger Avarek 280
# --- g3: skill 90, gear none ---
setstat Avarek swimming 90
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_bonus Avarek swimming ~ equipped_bonus=0% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek -62153 100 34366.6 ~ moved=1
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
water Avarek ~ water_level=deep
@set RS runspeed Avarek ~ (swim_speed=[\d.]+ max_swim_speed=[\d.]+)
stat Avarek swimming
runspeed Avarek
@set T swimtime Avarek 60 +z ~ (deep_seconds=[\d.]+ deep_dist=[\d.]+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,194,swimming_fs,90,0,none,g3,swim,0,${T},${RS}
pg_statprobe read
hunger Avarek 280
# --- g4: skill 25, gear none ---
setstat Avarek swimming 25
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_bonus Avarek swimming ~ equipped_bonus=0% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek -62153 100 34366.6 ~ moved=1
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
water Avarek ~ water_level=deep
@set RS runspeed Avarek ~ (swim_speed=[\d.]+ max_swim_speed=[\d.]+)
stat Avarek swimming
runspeed Avarek
@set T swimtime Avarek 60 +z ~ (deep_seconds=[\d.]+ deep_dist=[\d.]+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,194,swimming_fs,25,0,none,g4,swim,0,${T},${RS}
pg_statprobe read
hunger Avarek 280
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 3 ~ moved=1
pg_formulas off
